answer: The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, reset on any identity-link attempt, rewards vest against future work. The plume holds work receipts rather than names, so the ripple of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Reaching the anchor of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
